stem: Ella, Faye and Gino share ₱36,000 in the ratio 1 : 2 : 7. How much more does Gino get than Ella and Faye together?
hints: There are three people, so add all three numbers to get the total parts.
Gino has 7 parts. Ella and Faye together have 1 + 2 parts. Find the difference in parts, then multiply by the value of one part.

steps.why: Dividing by 10 just takes one zero off the end.

steps.action: Ella and Faye together have 1 + 2 = 3 parts. Gino has 7 parts.
Find the difference in parts: 7 − 3 = 4 parts.
steps.why: Working in parts saves time. You do not need every share in pesos.
4 × 36 = 144, then put back the two zeros.

steps.action: So Gino gets ₱14,400 more than Ella and Faye together.

trapNotes.₱25,200: This is Gino's whole share (7 × ₱3,600). The question asks how much more he gets than the other two together.
trapNotes.₱3,600: This is the value of one part. Gino has 4 more parts than Ella and Faye together, so multiply it by 4.
trapNotes.₱18,000: This compares Gino with Faye only (7 − 2 = 5 parts). Ella and Faye together have 1 + 2 = 3 parts.
